post.description:
Manual egress probe (t052 AC-006/AC-009).

The request carries no body: only the proxy id is accepted, and the
stored endpoint + credentials are loaded server-side, so a caller can
never redirect the stored password to another host, port, scheme or
username.  Any request body is rejected (AC-009 negative path).

get.description: Download public root CA certificate only (AC-008). No private keys.

schema.title: Response List Control Tunnels Api V1 Profiles  Profile Id  Control Tunnels Get

get.description:
Peek dialogs held by the resident attendant (automation token).

A session attached after a dialog opened cannot observe it through
its own CDP session (t031 chain evidence), so a later session
peeks here before deciding whether to answer via the attendant.
The peek is gated to the controlling agent (see
``_require_dialog_agent``).

post.description:
Answer a held dialog on the attendant's session (automation token).

Gated to the controlling agent (see ``_require_dialog_agent``):
a taken-over profile or a second token cannot answer dialogs.

post.description:
Human-input takeover reported by the Gateway (t031).

The Stream Agent classifies a foreground viewer input, the Gateway
forwards it here, and the control service moves the profile to the
user, closes tunnels, and broadcasts the new state. Idempotent:
reporting a takeover for an already-user profile is a no-op.

ControlClaimRequest.title: ControlClaimRequest
ControlClaimRequest.description:
Claim request (t031_code_f005: read the field notes).

``agent_instance_id`` is accepted but IGNORED: the recorded
instance identity always comes from the automation token id, so a
caller-supplied instance never renames the claim. Only
``agent_session_id`` is honored (it scopes the claim to a session).

ControlHandoffRequest.title: ControlHandoffRequest
ControlHandoffRequest.description:
Handoff request (t031_code_f005: read the field notes).

Handoff is fail-open toward the user: the identity fields are
accepted but IGNORED (any automation-token holder may move a
profile back to the safe state; the server does not check that the
caller is the controlling agent). Only ``reason``/``detail`` act.

FontSetListResponse.title: FontSetListResponse
FontSetListResponse.description:
Font sets plus the backend-chosen default per platform (t053 A16).

``default_font_set_id`` is decided only by the backend, from the same
integrity-ok rule as profile creation; the create form preselects it
and never derives a default of its own.

ProfileControlStateData.title: ProfileControlStateData
ProfileControlStateData.description:
Human-priority control state for one profile (t031, ADR 019).

``owner`` is ``user`` by default and after every restart, crash,
identity failure, or takeover; ``agent`` only while an explicitly
claimed agent session holds control. ``generation`` increases on
every ownership change and fences stale tunnel messages, control
responses, and SSE snapshots. ``agent_reclaim_allowed`` is cleared
by a takeover and only restored by an explicit human restore or a
clean agent finish, so a taken-over agent cannot silently re-claim
control through a fresh tunnel handshake.

ProxyCreateRequest.title: ProxyCreateRequest
ProxyCreateRequest.description:
Link-only entry (t052): the proxy link is the single source of
truth for the endpoint; ``name`` defaults to ``host:port``.

ProxyResponse.title: ProxyResponse
ProxyResponse.description:
Public proxy view (t052).

``country_code`` / ``egress_ip`` / ``observation_status`` are read-only
observations: they come from the current valid egress observation for
the proxy's present endpoint fingerprint and credential revision, never
from a stored writable field.  ``proxy_url`` is the redacted link (no
password, ever); the password is never present in any response.

ProxyUpdateRequest.title: ProxyUpdateRequest
ProxyUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH semantics (t052): ``proxy_url`` omitted = endpoint unchanged;
supplied = endpoint (including password) replaced wholesale.  All
other fields are optional; ``name``/``region_label``/``notes`` may be
set to null to clear.

SearchDefaultsStatusData.title: SearchDefaultsStatusData
SearchDefaultsStatusData.description:
API view of the runtime agent's search-defaults outcome (t022 A55).

Mirrors the runtime agent protocol model; kept independent of browser
readiness: a failed initialization is reported here, never as a
runtime failure.

TransportObservationData.title: TransportObservationData
TransportObservationData.description:
API view of the Supervisor's layered transport observation (t026).

Mirrors the Supervisor control protocol model. Held in memory only:
after an API restart the value is ``unknown`` until the Supervisor
reports again, never a stale persisted copy.
